result.prompt: Use the supplied image as the starting frame and strict visual reference. Create a 6-second, silent, 1:1 video in one continuous shot. Preserve the woman in her original position within the frame, with three fixed anchors: her exact facial identity, her curly dark hair, and her gray knitted sweater. Preserve the sweater’s knit texture and fit. Preserve the leafy park setting, foliage arrangement, original lighting, colors, and photographic style. Use one very slow, subtle camera push-in throughout, keeping her face comfortably framed. From 0–1.5 seconds, let her expression gently develop into a relaxed, natural smile without changing her facial structure. From 1.5–4 seconds, have her look around a little: her eyes shift slightly to one side, her head follows by just a few degrees, and her gaze then eases back toward its starting direction. Keep her posture relaxed, with only slight breathing movement and a natural blink. From 4–6 seconds, hold on her face with the soft smile settled and minimal movement. Ensure the first frame matches the reference and the final frame retains the same identity, anatomy, clothing, and setting. Audio off; no text. Negatives: no dramatic expressions, broad head turns, talking, exaggerated gestures, facial drift, hair or clothing changes, distorted anatomy, background warping, cuts, or sudden camera movement.
